rows.requirement: Require accepted attempt 002 output, exact source blob, 92283 complete parse, three ordered unique finite Points.
Require accepted attempt 003 transformed points and complete object-ID-batched DTM/DSM catalogue discovery.
Require current release date, local-authority file list, archive/file SHA256 and source URLs.
Require selected survey object IDs, archive and GeoTIFF SHA256, product, survey date, resolution, transform and geoid.
Require parcel_61523, parcel_61524 and parcel_61525 exactly once and in canonical order.
Read HMLR geometry in native British National Grid and reject uncontrolled WGS84 reprojection artifacts.
Require a non-empty Land Registry INSPIRE ID for every candidate polygon.
Hash canonicalized polygon geometry and retain source-file SHA256 separately.
Deduplicate repeated local-authority rows by INSPIRE ID and geometry hash; reject conflicting geometry for the same ID.
Require non-empty valid Polygon or MultiPolygon; do not silently repair invalid geometry.
Require transformed Point to be covered by the selected polygon and report point-on-edge separately.
Classify every row as GENERAL_BOUNDARY or DETERMINED_BOUNDARY.
Require title-specific documentary evidence before any determined-boundary claim.
Require local raster file, bounded size and no unresolved archive extraction path.
Require exact GeoTIFF SHA256 and archive SHA256 before opening the raster.
Require EA LIDAR DTM Time Stamped as primary product; classify OS Terrain 5 only as fallback.
Require one numeric elevation band and reject palette, RGB or empty datasets.
Read the opened dataset CRS independently and require EPSG:27700.
Require ODN vertical-datum evidence from catalogue or product metadata.
Require OSGM15/geoid and accepted transform metadata; do not infer vertical datum from file extension.
Require native resolution in 0.25, 0.5, 1 or 2 m and match dataset pixel size to manifest.
Require survey date and live catalogue object ID for every selected DTM.
Read band NoData and permitted auxiliary metadata; reject NoData-only support.
Require transformed Point to fall inside dataset bounds before any sample.
Buffer polygon inward by max(two native cells, one metre) before extrema sampling.
Require at least 25 finite native DTM cells after polygon and NoData masking.
Reject windows above one million pixels to prevent accidental unbounded reads.
Calculate minimum, maximum and difference from native cells without interpolation.
Require at least eight finite boundary diagnostic samples and publish their range separately.
When DSM is present require matched grid, survey, resolution, transform, geoid and checksums.
Flag DSM-minus-DTM median above one metre; never substitute DSM extrema for ground height.
Write only declared height_difference_3 outputs; keep legal-boundary and final-ready claims false until full acceptance.
